title: Poems by Emily Dickinson, Three Series, Complete
author: Emily Dickinson (1830–1886)
scope: 444 poems from the three early published series; not the full modern catalog of 1,789 poems. These historical editions contain editorial changes.

rights.text: Public domain in the USA, as recorded by Project Gutenberg ebook12242.
rights.edition_note: Only text from the early published editions is included. No Johnson1955 or Franklin1998 text is imported.
rights.attribution: Emily Dickinson; early editors Mabel Loomis Todd and Thomas Wentworth Higginson; Project Gutenberg transcription produced by Jim Tinsley.
